home.app_intro: Two workshops, one goal: pages that need nobody. Compose from scratch with AI, or bring what already exists — either way, the tool makes the result autonomous.
home.cta_login: Already have an account? Sign in
home.f1_desc: Header, hero, pricing, FAQ… every block type has its own specialized generator, trained to produce agency-grade Tailwind. Describe, generate, then iterate by retouching — “make the background light” is enough.
home.f2_desc: Drop a .zip or .tar.gz of any static site — whatever the stack, as long as it's HTML. It becomes editable instantly.
home.f3_desc: Visual editing right inside the page: one click selects, a double-click edits, AI retouches the element without breaking its style. Purists get full-screen Monaco.
home.f4_desc: Attach a domain, point an A record: every “Save” is live within the second. No deployment, no database — the filesystem is the source of truth.
home.home_intro: The modern web chains every page to ten servers you don't own. NADAPROD is the open-source tool that turns every web publication into a self-contained work of art: complete, self-hosted, without a single dependency.
home.marquee: EVERYTHING IS LOCAL. / ZERO EXTERNAL REQUESTS. / NO CONCESSIONS. /
home.network_intro: The code is yours. DWTFYW license — “Do What The Fuck You Want” — MIT-compatible: use it, fork it, sell it, republish it. Below, works already published with the tool.
home.newsletter_more: Detailed application — join the waiting list
home.newsletter_sub: The public instance opens in waves. Leave your email for the next one — or clone the repo and host your own tonight.
home.sendError: Could not send — try again or write to contact@nadaprod.com
home.services_subtitle: Publishing is not enough. On every save, the pipeline rebuilds the published version into a complete artifact: everything it needs to live is inside.
home.svc_log_desc: No tracking cookies, no data collected, no request leaking to a third party. The banner doesn't apologize: it announces “everything stays local”, in the visitor's language.
home.svc_prod_desc: The Tailwind CDN becomes CSS compiled in place. Google Fonts become fonts served by your own site. A service worker makes the work installable and readable offline. You asked for none of it: it's the default.

sites.openStudioTitle: Open this page in the block studio
sites.pageNoAnswer: The page is not responding — reload it
sites.pageNoAnswerSave: The page is not responding — save it before switching to code mode
sites.selHelp: Click an element in the page to select it, double-click to edit its text, Esc to deselect.
sites.setCompileDesc: Replaces cdn.tailwindcss.com with CSS compiled on the server — faster, with no external dependency.
sites.setFontsDesc: fonts.googleapis.com fonts are copied and served by your own site — no request ever reaches Google.
sites.setGdprDesc: “Zero stress: everything stays local” — an OK button and a link to the legal notice.
sites.setPwaDesc: Generated manifest, icon and service worker: an installable site that works offline. If the site ships its own, they are respected.
sites.settingsNote: Applies to the published version (attached domain). The editor always works on the original source.
studio.conflictBody: This project was changed in another tab or on another device. Reload the page to start from the latest version: your very last changes here will not be saved.
studio.errStreamCut: The generation was cut off before completion
studio.err_auth_body: The server cannot authenticate with Gemini. To fix server-side: GEMINI_API_KEY in the .env file, then restart.
studio.err_blocked_body: Gemini's safety filters blocked this request. Rephrase the brief.
studio.err_empty_body: The model returned nothing usable (filtered or truncated). Retrying often works; otherwise simplify the brief.
studio.err_invalid_body: Gemini rejected the request (unknown model or invalid parameters). Check server-side: GEMINI_MODEL.
studio.err_network_body: The link to the server or to Gemini was cut.
studio.err_quota_body: The generation service hit its limit (requests per minute or daily quota). Wait a moment; if it persists, check the Gemini key's quota and billing.
studio.err_rate_limited_body: Too many generations in a row from your account. This limit protects the shared quota.
studio.err_timeout_body: The model did not answer in time. Retry, possibly with a shorter brief.
studio.err_upstream_body: The generation service returned an error. This is usually temporary.
studio.exportEmpty: Generate at least one block before exporting
studio.exportHTMLDesc: A single file, compiled and purged Tailwind CSS, SEO included.

studio.exportZIPDesc: index.html, styles.css, local images and fonts.

studio.qualityEmpty: Generate at least one block to analyse it.
studio.qualityHint: Automatic checks: contrast (WCAG AA), heading hierarchy, alt texts, field and button labels. Contrast over a gradient or an image cannot be measured and is therefore not reported.

studio.rethemePartial: {n} of {total} block(s) converted — the others failed
studio.rethemeWhy: Do this once for blocks generated before the theme was enabled: the AI swaps their hard-coded colours for tokens, without touching the copy.
studio.retouchHint: Double-click a text in the preview to fix it in place. Esc deselects.

studio.retouchPh: E.g. bigger button, in the accent colour
studio.retouchRoot: This is the whole block: to redo it, use its generator instead (leave retouch mode).
studio.seoHint: Left empty, the title and description are derived from the brand and the hero at export time.

studio.siteHint: The page is written to the site's source then published automatically (compiled CSS, local fonts, PWA, GDPR notice per the site's settings).
studio.themeHint: Colours, fonts and radii become tokens shared by every block: changing the theme updates the page instantly. It replaces the free-form palette above.
studio.themeStylePh: E.g. minimal and editorial, lots of white space
studio.tooManyBlocks: Maximum number of blocks reached for this project
studio.variantsHint: Three art directions generated in parallel from the same brief. Pick one: it replaces the block (undoable).
